description: The canonical memory epoch: from this point every memory byte leaving or entering Cursor-Governance crosses the l9-graphite-memory control plane, and the provider is a projection memory owns. Written at campaign stage C10 of CURSOR_GOVERNANCE_MEMORY_CONTROL_PLANE_REALIGNMENT_BUILD_PLAN; read by tests/ops/memory/test_canonical_epoch.py. It grants nothing.

epoch.memory_rebound_at: 2026-09-06 (audit closure C14: rebound from the M2 head to the final #56 head with the wheel digest); 2026-09-07 (source ref moved to the v2.3.0 release tag); 2026-09-08 (MEMORY_TARGET_VERSION moved to v2.3.1, first PyPI upload); 2026-09-13 (ADR-0031 candidate 2.4.0 signed-agent door)

authority.provider_role: projection-only; receives records solely through canonical projection
authority.rollback: no rollback path restores a direct provider write (plan §30)

session_lifecycle.mcp_instantiation: ops/memory/mcp_instantiation.py + l9-memory client cursor install/verify since C7
session_lifecycle.secret_plane: no provider URL or bearer on any surface since C9
session_lifecycle.offline_distill: ops/memory/control_plane_client.py distill -> l9-memory distill since C15 (the Cursor-local worker ran its own extraction and is deleted, ADR-0033)
session_lifecycle.distill_queue: retired at C15: ops/graphiti/distill_queue, .github/workflows/memory-distill.yml and run_distiller.sh are deleted; close_session hands the redacted excerpt to l9-memory distill in-process and closed_enqueue_failed is parse-only (ADR-0033)
session_lifecycle.local_cognition: none since C15: no provider client, model id, promotion rule or scorer on any memory path; extraction, admission and promotion are MemoryService's (ADR-0033, INV-03b)
session_lifecycle.lanes: since C15 agents write the public l9-memory / MCP surface directly (write_agent) and hooks write bounded through ops/memory/control_plane_client.py; both converge on MemoryService (ADR-0033, INV-03b)
session_lifecycle.generated_data: environment/agents/generated-data/adapters/ingest_memory_candidate.py through the control plane since C10

legacy_reconciliation.input: a provider export produced outside this boundary; Cursor-Governance never reads the provider

remaining_legacy.note: Inventoried by ops/config/memory-egress-allowlist.json; every entry names the stage that deletes it. Warning mode until C11 flips ops/scripts/validate_memory_egress_boundary.py to --enforce.
remaining_legacy.shadow_reader: ops/graphiti/hydration/compile_session_packet.py (MEMORY_LEGACY_SHADOW / MEMORY_LEGACY_CONTINUATION, off by default) — deleted at C11
